mainEntity.name: How long does it take to see results from GPP training?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for seeing results from GPP training varies based on individual consistency, starting fitness level, and the intensity of effort. Generally, clients often report increased energy levels, improved mood, and better movement quality within a few weeks of consistent training. Noticeable improvements in strength, endurance, and body composition typically become evident within 2-3 months. At Cave Training, our coaches regularly assess your progress and adjust programming to ensure continued development, making the process adaptive to your body's response.
